strings.app.title: Maker Studio
strings.app.brand.subtitle: ThreeMaker
strings.app.status.map: Maker Studio — map, events, ink, entities
strings.catalog.empty: No catalog found — run the bulk scan CLI first (see packages/assets).
strings.catalog.error: Failed to load the catalog — see console for details.
strings.viewer.unavailable: Map viewer unavailable — see console for details.
strings.painter.welcome.title: Welcome to Maker Studio
strings.painter.welcome.body: Author maps, events, dialogue, and entities in one studio. Create a map from catalog tilesets or open your last save — tools on the left, inspector on the right, canvas in the center.
strings.painter.paint.hint: Select a tool on the left rail, pick tiles in the palette below the map, then paint on the canvas.
strings.painter.layers.hint: Top = Over (drawn above the player). Bottom = Ground. Walls extrude in 2.5D when marked as wall.
strings.painter.palette.role.brush.hint: Click a swatch to set the paint brush (ground fill for Generate).
strings.painter.palette.role.wall.hint: Click a swatch to set the procgen wall tile override.
strings.painter.palette.role.door.hint: Click a swatch to set the procgen door tile (mid layer openings).
strings.painter.createFailed: Failed to create the map — see console for details.
strings.painter.loadFailed: Failed to load the map — see console for details.
strings.painter.saveSuccessShareQueued: Map saved · community share queued (offline until server).
strings.painter.saveFailed: Failed to save the map — see console for details.
strings.painter.procgen.hint: Brush = ground. Wall/door: pick id, from brush, or Auto. Same seed + preset = same layout. Spawn moves to the largest room; keeps events/NPCs.
strings.painter.procgen.wallFromBrushHint: Copy the current brush tile id as the wall tile
strings.painter.procgen.wallAutoHint: Use wall-layer majority or engine fallback
strings.painter.procgen.doorFromBrushHint: Copy the current brush tile id as the door tile (mid layer)
strings.painter.procgen.doorAutoHint: Use a door-class semantic tile if the map has one; otherwise openings only
strings.painter.procgen.needMap: Load or create a map before generating.
strings.painter.community.hint: By default maps queue for community share on save (offline until the server exists). Uncheck to keep saves local only.
strings.painter.community.shareOnSave: Share map with community on save
strings.painter.community.allowImported: Allow sharing maps that use imported RPGM assets
strings.painter.community.statusOff: Sharing off — saves stay local only.
strings.painter.community.statusReady: Sharing on — next save will queue offline.
strings.painter.empty.noMapBody: Create or load a map to paint, generate dungeons, and author events.
strings.painter.events.emptyBody: Add an event key below to start a command script (NPC interact, triggers).
strings.painter.rooms.emptyBody: Use New room / Room tool (R), or Generate a dungeon to fill floor-0 rooms.
strings.painter.props.selectHint: Select a .glb before placing a prop.
strings.painter.props.libraryHint: Click an object to list-place it (tool O).
strings.painter.props.libraryEmptyBody: Import a .glb — active and placed objects appear here for reuse.
strings.painter.props.selectedToast: Object {sha}… ready — click map or Place at tile.
strings.painter.props.emptyBody: Import a .glb, pick it in the object library, then Place at tile or use tool O.
strings.painter.props.reuseToast: Prop {id} object {sha}… ready — place another copy (O).
strings.painter.props.ingestFailed: Failed to import the .glb — see console for details.
strings.painter.props.ingestNeedsTauri: Importing .glb requires the Tauri editor host.
strings.painter.events.deleteReferenced: Cannot delete: still referenced by an NPC onInteract or trigger event. Unlink first.
strings.painter.events.noSelection: Select or add an event key to edit its command list.
strings.painter.events.field.speaker: Speaker
strings.painter.events.dialogueInkHint: Text lines here, or switch to ink and edit the sidecar in the Ink section.
strings.painter.ink.help: Sidecars save next to the map as current.<storyId>.ink. Open a story id or pick one referenced by Events.
strings.painter.ink.none: No story open yet — type a story id and click Open.
strings.painter.ink.invalidStoryId: Story id must be letters, digits, _ or - only.
strings.painter.ink.saveFailed: Failed to save ink sidecar — see console.
strings.painter.ink.loadFailed: Failed to load ink sidecar — see console.
strings.painter.ink.saveBlocked: Fix compile errors before saving ink.
strings.painter.ink.graphHint: Drag knots to save layout in @tm-node comments. Edges are a visual guide only.
strings.painter.npcs.eventsHint: Author event scripts in the Events section above. Routine editing stays JSON-side.
strings.painter.npcs.noEventsHint: This map has no events — add one in the Events section before placing NPCs.
strings.painter.npcs.selectSpriteHint: Select a character sprite before placing an NPC.
strings.painter.npcs.emptyBody: Pick a sprite and event, then Place at tile or use tool N on the map.
strings.painter.npcs.reuseToast: NPC {id} settings loaded — place another copy (N).
strings.painter.triggers.eventsHint: Author event scripts in the Events section above.
strings.painter.triggers.noEventsHint: This map has no events — add one in the Events section before placing triggers.
strings.painter.triggers.emptyBody: Pick enter/interact and an event, then Place at tile or use tool T on the map.
strings.painter.triggers.reuseToast: Trigger {id} settings loaded — place another copy (T).
strings.painter.stairLinks.emptyBody: Use the Stair link tool (S): click entry on one floor, then exit on another.
strings.painter.stairLink.pendingHint: Click the exit tile on the destination floor to finish the stair link.
